content.short: Flipside is a crypto data platform for querying blockchain activity, sharing insights, and building analytics on Mantle.
content.description: Flipside is a crypto analytics platform that gives analysts and developers access to structured blockchain data, query tools, and shared research workflows. Its docs and product updates emphasize SQL queries, API access, automations, AI-assisted analysis, and a community model where users publish dashboards or contribute insights. That makes it useful for teams building data products and for researchers tracking user behavior, protocol growth, and network activity. For Mantle, Flipside fits as an analytics layer for exploring datasets, publishing research, and turning blockchain activity into usable metrics.
